guidelines.detail: documentation rule ACT-07 not applied (The description states that the applicant may review the rejection reasons, but gives no further decision or synchronization before the rejected outcome. The reported gateway is therefore unsupported by the described flow; ACT-07 already advises using gateways when a decision or synchronization is required.)

refines FID-02 (The description distinguishes submitting the request from registering it before the supervisor receives it, and the reference includes a separate registration task absent from the generated model. This refines FID-02 by specifying a recurring situation in which separately described actions must remain separate; LRN-080 expresses a closely related learned principle.)

same as LRN-082 (The description identifies registration as occurring before receipt by the next responsible participant, and the reference contains a separate registration task and its adjacent flows. This guideline matches learned guideline LRN-082.)

same as LRN-082 (The description distinguishes submitting the request from its subsequent registration before it is received by the supervisor. The generated submission activity has no counterpart for the separately described registration activity.)

same as LRN-078 (The description supports a distinct registration activity before the request is received. The other apparent activity mismatch has a generated counterpart, and the described review does not support the reference model’s added decision gateway.)

same as LRN-082 (The description places registration after submission and before the supervisor receives the request, while M1 records that registration has no counterpart. The generated task in X1 appears to cover the management procedures in M2, so that difference does not support treating those procedures as missing. The proposed guideline is already captured by LRN-082.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity is followed by a single process outcome and does not describe a further decision or synchronization

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description distinguishes submitting an item from a later registration or recording of that item before another activity: Model submission and registration as separate BPMN activities, preserving their stated order and any stated dependency.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description distinguishes submitting an item from a later registration or recording of that item before another activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that one activity is completed before a different activity begins: Model each stated activity as its own activity in the stated order; do not use one activity as a substitute for another.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that one activity is completed before a different activity begins
